body_markdown:
Recap


AI is revolutionizing drug discovery. But there’s a billion-dollar problem nobody talks about: Making what AI discovers. As artificial intelligence unlocks an entirely new world of molecules and potential medicines, traditional manufacturing may struggle to keep pace. In this[Mashable feature](https://nl.mashable.com/ai-1/13484/ai-and-digital-biology-is-accelerating-drug-discovery-can-manufacturing-keep-up) , discover how eXoZymes is working to bridge the gap between AI-powered discovery and real-world production - potentially changing how tomorrow’s medicines are made.
